Looping in a few implementation details that usually come up during procurement and security reviews — copying text you can paste into the questionnaire where helpful.

Incident response & BCP notes (for questionnaire / redlines):
- SOC 2: Redwood completed a Type II audit in 2025 covering the Inference Platform and Control Plane. Full report is available under NDA; SOC2-status-summary.pdf contains scope, auditor, and remediations.
- IR detection/response: mean time to detection targets are dependent on signal; confirmed incident classification target is 24 hours, containment procedures are prioritized within 48 hours.
- Notification timelines: standard customer notification target within 72 hours of confirming a reportable data breach. Contractual exceptions can be discussed but require alignment with Legal.
- Logs & evidence: we retain audit logs for 1 year by default; extended retention is available for Dedicated/Private customers under contract.
- BCP: typical RTO is 1-4 hours for control-plane operations and 4-24 hours for model-serving tiers depending on redundancy level. RPO targets are documented in attached slides.

Attachments referenced to share with FinTechCorp: SOC2-status-summary.pdf, BCP_DR_Slides.pdf. I can also provide a redacted IR playbook excerpt if they need more detail — will prepare a 2-page excerpt if requested.

LMK if you want me on the follow-up call 7/22.

Thanks —
